reason: I already know wheels and I'm not short of options on Marketplace, so a brand new seller with no reviews doesn't get me over the line. The in-person check and fit guarantee help, but I'd want to see the set before I believe any of it.
objection: New seller, no reviews. Photos and a balancer report can be faked, and a refund promise from someone with no track record is just words. I also don't need a set right now unless it's my exact PCD and offset.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing the set in person first with the bend and crack check done in front of me, in my exact PCD and offset, or a few real reviews from local buyers.
